id: title:Gilbert09:add a deadline and keepalive to google ads calls

review.posthog_relevance: Adds campaign-sharded resource resumption, gRPC keepalive and timeout settings, and deadline-exceeded error handling to Google Ads warehouse ingestion, supporting warehouse ingestion reliability and recovery.
review.reason: The supplied observations describe substantive, bounded improvements to warehouse ingestion: campaign-specific resumption, connection stability, and timeout handling. These are not narrow maintenance or documentation-only changes. observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds campaign_id to GoogleAdsResumeConfig and its save state, while retaining page_token.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to resume from a campaign-specific page token rather than restarting the whole account, supporting campaign-sharded resources.

observations.behavior: Defines campaign-sharded resources and the campaign ID query, and adds gRPC keepalive and timeout settings.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds gRPC keepalive and timeout settings to prevent hanging connections and unresponsive calls during warehouse ingestion.

observations.behavior: Adds GoogleAdsCallDeadlineExceeded exception and its detection, and raises it when a call exceeds the timeout.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to distinguish between transient and deadline-exceeded errors, and treat the latter as a retryable failure rather than a transient error.
